{"consolidated_memory":"## Off-by-one day in DatePicker.tsx: three separate occasions with different root causes

All three incidents involved the same problem symptom (off-by-one day in the date picker with selected value one day behind the label) in ui/components/DatePicker.tsx (web ui), but triggered under different conditions, with different root causes, and requiring different fixes. All reproduced with: pick the first of the month and reopen. All covered by test: ui/components/DatePicker.test.tsx. Stack: TypeScript.

### Occasion 1: [2026-05-25] Fleet rolling restart trigger
- Trigger: appeared only after a rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: error swallowed by a bare except
- Fix: narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #1607 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-1
- Result: memory settled at 874 MB instead of climbing past 8 GB

### Occasion 2: [2026-05-31] Corporate proxy traffic trigger
- Trigger: appeared only for traffic through the corporate proxy
- Root cause: race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR #3611 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-2
- Result: the nightly rollup matched the source counts for 78 days running

### Occasion 3: [2026-08-25] OAuth provider sessions trigger
- Trigger: appeared only for sessions through the OAuth provider
- Root cause: mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR #3723 on branch fix/off-by-one-day-3
- Result: reclaimed 29 GB of blob storage"}
